comment: THE ONE TABLE of words shown in place of a code (R-2026-09-23-68 C), shared by the public page and, since R-2026-09-23-70 E, the ward console, so the two cannot disagree. Moved here from apps/public-dashboard/src/ by PR 3.4a. The public page never prints a raw code: every value of every enum the page receives is either given words here under `labels`, or named under `not_yet_displayed` with the reason it is not shown. tests/compliance/public_labels.test.ts derives those enums and their values from the migrations, and tests/db/public_labels_enum.test.ts from the database catalogue, so a value added to an enum turns both red until it is decided here. An empty string is a deliberate decision that the value adds no words to the line (OFFERED, ACTIVE, WARD, OK). A code the page receives that is not in this table renders the fallback and is logged, never shown. Words only the ward console shows (the zero reasons, the offering choice) live in ward-labels.json beside this file, because this table must cover EXACTLY what the public page receives.
